authority: Explicit operator instruction (in-session). Refines decision D14 in the plan of record (PHASE8_FULLSCALE_AND_OBSIDIAN_GRILL_BRIEF.md and MILESTONE1_DECISION_RECORD.md). This is a milestone-decision refinement, NOT a CLAUDE.md constitutional amendment: the §12.2 status enum, the β/W1 mechanism, and every gate are unchanged. Logged per §9.4.
refines: D14 (Definition of done) and ticket 13 (End-to-end MSCA-PF run) acceptance criteria.
prior_rule: D14: milestone-1 'done' = every Phase-8 gate GREEN (all `Assumed` operator-declared, W1 satisfied) OR an honest block naming the unconfirmed claims. Under this rule a β-green built on operator-declared `Assumed` claims counted as a completed proposal.
refined_rule: A FINALIZED proposal admits only `Confirmed` or `Inferred` (proven and justified) claims. `Assumed` and `Unresolved` claims may NOT appear in a finalized deliverable. The finalization run must therefore be executed on project data consolidated to Confirmed/Inferred. The β / operator-declared-`Assumed` path and the SYN-SPINE-01 synthetic spine are DEMOTED to interim testing affordances used to exercise the phases before the real data is consolidated; they are no longer done-conditions. The α honest block remains a valid terminal state (it is the correct outcome whenever data is not yet consolidated).
what_this_does_NOT_change: The closed four-value §12.2 status enum (Confirmed / Inferred / Assumed / Unresolved) is unchanged. No status is added or removed.

The β mechanism (working_assumptions.json + assumption-applier) and the W1 predicate (assumed_claims_are_operator_declared) remain built, valid, and in force. They are the honest interim-run mechanism and the anti-fabrication guarantee. What changes is only that a β-green is not a *finalized* proposal.

Every gate is unchanged. no_unresolved_material_claims still passes on `assumed`; W1 still guards `assumed`. The finalization standard is enforced by the DATA (consolidated to Confirmed/Inferred) and by human judgment at finalization, not by weakening or altering a gate.
The honest-block behaviour (α) is unchanged and remains the headline demonstration that the engine refuses to fabricate.
why: The operator clarified that `Assumed`/`Unresolved` were working values adopted to let the phases run against not-yet-consolidated data, and that SYN-SPINE-01 was a demo device. The production goal is a finalized proposal, which must rest only on confirmed or justified-inferred facts. Admitting `Assumed` claims into a finalized deliverable would ship a proposal containing values that are, by their own provenance, not yet true - the opposite of the honesty the system exists to protect.
consequences: Ticket 13 cannot fully close on synthetic (SYN-SPINE-01) or β-declared data. Its finalization leg now requires the real project data consolidated to Confirmed/Inferred.

This decouples two things that D14 had bundled: (a) proving the engine integrates end-to-end (which α/β runs on scaffolding data can demonstrate), and (b) producing a finalized proposal (which requires consolidated Confirmed/Inferred data). Engine-readiness can be established without waiting for project-data consolidation; finalization cannot.
The α honest block already captured (tag alpha-honest-block) remains valid and is unaffected.

The two preconditions for finalization are now explicit: (a) DATA consolidated to Confirmed/Inferred (project-side), and (b) ORCHESTRATOR proven ready to draft at length without breaking a gate (engine-side).
next_steps: Update ticket 13 acceptance criteria to the refined standard (keep α as a valid terminal state; mark β/synthetic as interim-only).
Engine-readiness audit (token-free): confirm the Stage 3-6 build is sound and the Phase 7-8 wiring is complete, before committing quota to a finalization run.
Consolidate the real project data to Confirmed/Inferred (project-side): close RQ1-RQ10 and confirm the real researcher/host/supervisor spine.
Then run the finalization: Phases 1-8 on consolidated data, .docx export, both byte-equal CI checks, independent subagent re-verification.
constitutional_note: This narrows a milestone done-condition toward MORE honesty, not less. It removes a path by which a proposal could be called 'done' while still resting on unconfirmed values. It is §13.7-clean (it strengthens, not weakens, the standard) and requires no gate change - the enforcement is that the finalization data must be Confirmed/Inferred, checked by the same honesty gates already in place plus human judgment at sign-off.
